title: ChroSpin - ProteinA/G
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vvte66n
materials: Do you want to purify antibodies or sanitize your column? Please choose below.

steps.title: Prepare and load sample
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to pH 7.5‑8.5 and 150‑300 mM NaCl (e.g., add 1/11 volume of 0.5 M Tris, 2 M NaCl, pH 8.0). Use 2‑3 mg antibody per sample and add up to 500 µL to the top of the ChroSpin Protein A/G column. Incubate with end‑over‑end mixing or occasional inversion for 3 min (30 s for fast‑binding antibodies, up to 10 min for slow‑binding; longer times increase background).

steps.title: Collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 1000 g for 30‑60 s, place it into a clean receiver tube, and keep the flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE).

steps.title: Wash column (first wash)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL wash buffer to the column, close the lid, invert 5 times, then centrifuge at 1000 g for 30‑60 s and discard the receiver tube.

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL elution buffer to the column, close the lid, invert three times, and centrifuge at 1000 g for 30‑60 s. Repeat the addition of 200 µL elution buffer and centrifugation once more to obtain a second eluate.

steps.title: Prepare used column (optional)
steps.instruction: If the column has been previously used, first remove the storage solution by centrifugation at 1000 g for 30‑60 s. Then add 500 µL wash buffer, invert sharply 3‑5 times, and centrifuge at 1000 g for 30‑60 s. Repeat this washing step up to 5 times for increased purity; optionally include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl in the wash buffer to reduce nonspecific hydrophobic or ionic interactions.

steps.title: Post‑purification wash & storage prep
steps.instruction: Wash the column sequentially: (a) add 500 µL elution buffer and centrifuge at 1000 g for 30‑60 s; (b) add 500 µL wash buffer and centrifuge 30‑60 s; (c) add 500 µL deionized water and centrifuge 30‑60 s. Then add 500 µL 20 % ethanol (or wash buffer containing 0.05 % w/v sodium azide), close the bottom of the column, and store at room temperature or 4‑8 °C. For long‑term storage, dry the open (top and bottom) column in an oven at 80 °C for at least 2 h (or overnight), ensure the bottom stopper is completely dry, re‑attach the outlet, close the lid, and keep the column closed at room temperature.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add two drops of neutralization solution to the collected eluate and mix gently.

steps.title: Sanitize column (if required)
steps.instruction: Close the bottom of the column, add 500 µL sanitization solution, close the lid, and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature. Afterwards, remove the bottom cap, centrifuge at 1000 g for 30‑60 s, and wash three times with 500 µL deionized water (centrifuge each wash at 1000 g for 30‑60 s).

steps.title: Final storage preparation
steps.instruction: Close the bottom of the column and add 500 µL PBS containing 0.05 % w/v sodium azide. Close the lid and store the column at room temperature or 4‑8 °C; wait at least 12 hours before the next purification. For long‑term storage, dry the open column at 80 °C for ≥2 h (or overnight), ensure the bottom stopper is dry, re‑attach the outlet, close the lid, and keep the column closed at room temperature.
